root_cause.text: The f2fs_write_end_io() function accesses the superblock structure (sbi) after calling folio_end_writeback(), which can race with umount's kill_f2fs_super() that frees sbi, causing a use-after-free when get_pages() is called on freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the checkpoint thread wakeup logic (including the get_pages() call that accesses sbi) from after folio_end_writeback() to before it. The commit message explicitly states: "we should access sbi before folio_end_writeback() to avoid racing w/ kill_f2fs_super()" and explains that kill_f2fs_super() drops page caches before freeing sbi, guaranteeing all folios end writeback before sbi is freed. The original code had get_pages(sbi, F2FS_WB_CP_DATA) executing after folio_end_writeback(), which allowed the umount path to free sbi in the window between the folio writeback completion and the sbi access.
